detaileddescription.para: Note that this is affected by the build configuration and the CPU flags mask, so e.g. if the CPU supports AVX, but libavutil has been built with disable-avx or the AV_CPU_FLAG_AVX flag has been disabled through av_set_cpu_flags_mask(), then this function will behave as if AVX is not present.
